recordedControlOpenLoopPhysics.interpretation: Short-step production-prior dynamics under recorded controls are tight relative to the kilometer-scale 60-120 s closed-loop drift. Long-horizon error is therefore not explained by numerical integration alone; shadow/control-policy divergence and incomplete/sparse aerodynamic support materially contribute, while the ~41% p95 force residual confirms remaining physics uncertainty.
